## Summary

I extended the business-day rule in `OwnerRestControllerV1.rollToBusinessDay` to also roll past public holidays.

**Change** (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`):

- Added a fixed `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` set: `2026-01-01`, `2026-01-26`, `2026-04-25`, `2026-12-25`, `2026-12-28`.
- Rewrote `rollToBusinessDay` to roll forward one day at a time while the date is a weekend **or** a listed holiday, returning the next non-holiday business day. Extracted a small `isWeekend` helper.

The one-day-at-a-time loop correctly handles chains where holidays and weekends abut — e.g. `2026-12-25` (Fri, holiday) → Sat → Sun → `2026-12-28` (Mon, holiday) → `2026-12-29` (Tue). The adjusted value remains the source for all derived fields (membership-number year, daily-limit count), unchanged from before.

The existing invariant tests (Cp20, Cp47) and all other acceptance tests pass.
